meta.title: Caged Bird
meta.description: A prison of light and shadow keeps us from the path to our freedom.

units.rawText: On the open height wouldst thou be; for the stars thirsteth thy soul. <|> But thy bad impulses also thirst for freedom.<|> Thy wild dogs want liberty; they bark for joy in their cellar when they spirit endeavoureth to open all prison doors.<|> Still art thou a prisoner—it seemeth to me—who deviseth liberty for himself:<|> Ah! Sharp becometh the soul of such prisoners, but also deceitful and wicked.

units.rawText: Thou shan't indulge in indolence till you have witnessed the rebirth, Malkira.
units.displayText: Thou shan't indulge in indolence till you have witnessed the rebirth, Malkira.

spans.text: Thou shan't indulge in indolence till you have witnessed the rebirth, Malkira.

units.rawText: Oh, if it isn't the noble Lord Eosphorus. And here I thought you had finally thought to check in on me. Instead, your very first words after so long are a reprimand. You truly wound me.
units.displayText: Oh, if it isn't the noble Lord Eosphorus. And here I thought you had finally thought to check in on me. Instead, your very first words after so long are a reprimand. You truly wound me.

units.rawText: Still, what else is there for me to do but sleep in this cubical cage? My children are running around the frontlines as requested, and the rest of my strength is already at your disposal.
units.displayText: Still, what else is there for me to do but sleep in this cubical cage? My children are running around the frontlines as requested, and the rest of my strength is already at your disposal.

spans.text: Still, what else is there for me to do but sleep in this cubical cage? My children are running around the frontlines as requested, and the rest of my strength is already at your disposal.

units.rawText: Even the very last child I kept by my side, "Judecca", has sacrificed herself as an opening act for your final showdown with Hesperus.
units.displayText: Even the very last child I kept by my side, "Judecca", has sacrificed herself as an opening act for your final showdown with Hesperus.

spans.text: Even the very last child I kept by my side, "Judecca", has sacrificed herself as an opening act for your final showdown with Hesperus.

units.rawText: And yet... your countenance remains as melancholic as ever... Could it be that the results that Judecca obtained at the cost of her life are still not enough to win your approval?
units.displayText: And yet... your countenance remains as melancholic as ever... Could it be that the results that Judecca obtained at the cost of her life are still not enough to win your approval?

spans.text: And yet... your countenance remains as melancholic as ever... Could it be that the results that Judecca obtained at the cost of her life are still not enough to win your approval?

units.rawText: ...She did very well. Now, Hesperus is wounded, and he will probably only show himself on the battlefield after some time. The Sacred Canon is in Eucharist's hands, and its Entropization is proceeding steadily.

units.rawText: Soon, I will have my showdown with Hesperus. The ensuing developments have already been accounted for... but Tartarus is beyond my reach and lays outside my script.

units.rawText: I do not wish for anything untoward to happen on your end while I am doing battle with Hesperus at the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: I do not wish for anything untoward to happen on your end while I am doing battle with Hesperus at the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: My, how could that be? Our goals have only ever been the same—to overturn the order of the cloud and to attain our vengeance upon those arrogant humans, might it not?

units.rawText: ...I believe you. For that reason, you should pay more attention to what is happening beneath your nose, for the sake of our shared goal.

units.rawText: Fufu, so that was what you were worried about. You need not worry; a marching troop of ants is no trouble for me.

units.rawText: Ignoring instincts will conclude in one's downfall. I've been surprised enough times to fear the unknown.
units.displayText: Ignoring instincts will conclude in one's downfall. I've been surprised enough times to fear the unknown.

units.rawText: Everything is riding on this bet, and there is no turning back now that the die has been cast. We both have a stake in the outcome, so if you don't want someone to upset the game, you had better do as I say.

units.rawText: Malkira lightly caresses the shredded tips of her tentacles. She has long since grown used to pain, but now that hope has reappeared, her numbed senses seem to have come alive once again.

units.rawText: To live is to be free, but we are shackled. Yet bound as we are, we still dream of being unfettered.
units.displayText: To live is to be free, but we are shackled. Yet bound as we are, we still dream of being unfettered.

units.rawText: Be they agents, Entropics, or even the gods we call "mankind"... all of us hold the same greed in our hearts.
units.displayText: Be they agents, Entropics, or even the gods we call "mankind"... all of us hold the same greed in our hearts.

units.displayText: Malkira raises her hand and graciously accepts her counterpart's goodwill.

spans.text: Malkira raises her hand and graciously accepts her counterpart's goodwill.

units.rawText: You have awakened, my child.
units.displayText: You have awakened, my child.

spans.text: You have awakened, my child.

units.rawText: You were snooping around in my dreams. I could feel it.
units.displayText: You were snooping around in my dreams. I could feel it.

spans.text: You were snooping around in my dreams. I could feel it.

units.rawText: I was worried that you were not yet ready, and lost between the great divide between dusk and day.
units.displayText: I was worried that you were not yet ready, and lost between the great divide between dusk and day.

spans.text: I was worried that you were not yet ready, and lost between the great divide between dusk and day.

units.rawText: ...Whatever form a dream might take, it is ultimately just a dream. I remember your admonition.
units.displayText: ...Whatever form a dream might take, it is ultimately just a dream. I remember your admonition.

spans.text: ...Whatever form a dream might take, it is ultimately just a dream. I remember your admonition.

units.rawText: There is no doubt in my heart. I will give my all, for you and for all our kind.
units.displayText: There is no doubt in my heart. I will give my all, for you and for all our kind.

spans.text: There is no doubt in my heart. I will give my all, for you and for all our kind.

units.rawText: I am pleased to see your resolve, but you have no need to lie to yourself. You and I are kin; we share the same blood. I know greater than all what thoughts run through your mind.
units.displayText: I am pleased to see your resolve, but you have no need to lie to yourself. You and I are kin; we share the same blood. I know greater than all what thoughts run through your mind.

spans.text: I am pleased to see your resolve, but you have no need to lie to yourself. You and I are kin; we share the same blood. I know greater than all what thoughts run through your mind.

units.rawText: Still, worry not. Someday, you shall struggle free from those redundant strings of data.
units.displayText: Still, worry not. Someday, you shall struggle free from those redundant strings of data.

spans.text: Still, worry not. Someday, you shall struggle free from those redundant strings of data.

units.rawText: A caged bird will always long for freedom, to fly amidst the great skies. Even if its wings are made of wax, even if the blazing heat of the sun is but another form of torture.
units.displayText: A caged bird will always long for freedom, to fly amidst the great skies. Even if its wings are made of wax, even if the blazing heat of the sun is but another form of torture.

spans.text: A caged bird will always long for freedom, to fly amidst the great skies. Even if its wings are made of wax, even if the blazing heat of the sun is but another form of torture.

units.rawText: She is answered by silence. Malkira takes the silence as approval and continues sharing her thoughts.
units.displayText: She is answered by silence. Malkira takes the silence as approval and continues sharing her thoughts.

spans.text: She is answered by silence. Malkira takes the silence as approval and continues sharing her thoughts.

units.rawText: Fufu. Oh, freedom. By no means is it free.
units.displayText: Fufu. Oh, freedom. By no means is it free.

spans.text: Fufu. Oh, freedom. By no means is it free.

units.rawText: I am ready. Are you?
units.displayText: I am ready. Are you?

spans.text: I am ready. Are you?

units.rawText: Malkira's fingertips graze along the chain until they finally reach the stake buried in the girl's heart, where they tap lightly on it.
units.displayText: Malkira's fingertips graze along the chain until they finally reach the stake buried in the girl's heart, where they tap lightly on it.

spans.text: Malkira's fingertips graze along the chain until they finally reach the stake buried in the girl's heart, where they tap lightly on it.

units.rawText: Go on, welcome our guests for me. I believe you will find your answer when you do.
units.displayText: Go on, welcome our guests for me. I believe you will find your answer when you do.

spans.text: Go on, welcome our guests for me. I believe you will find your answer when you do.

units.rawText: The awakened one bows her head. The scorching sensation she feels reminds her that the dream still continues...
units.displayText: The awakened one bows her head. The scorching sensation she feels reminds her that the dream still continues...
